name: Stable Audio 3 (CPU service)
description:
Stable Audio 3 medium (LiteRT/TFLite) music generation on the CPU: POST /generate, GET /health.
This describes the locally built sa3 service image as it runs today: the image already on the host, its service folder, the stable-audio-3 source and the Hugging Face cache mounted at the paths the image expects.

service_dir.description: The sa3 service folder (server.py, runtime/, out/); mounted read-write at the same path.

src_dir.description: The stable-audio-3 source checkout; mounted read-only at the same path.

hf_cache.description: The Hugging Face cache holding stabilityai/stable-audio-3-optimized; mounted read-only at the same path.

min_avail_gb.description: Refuse a job when less RAM than this is available.

host_mounts.why: the service code and its output folder (the image runs server.py from here)
the stable-audio-3 source the service runs

notes: The model is under the Stability AI Community License; check it before use.
The image must already be on the host (built from the service folder); nothing is fetched or verified.
